native_findings: Birdeye token/pool and Dex cap extraction used FDV when reported cap was absent or invalid. Birdeye also overwrote the original FDV alias with cap.
Common tick coercion treated FDV as cap. Basic filters could replace known zero/unknown cap with FDV; stale aliases could survive cap rejection.

Removing incompatible cap/bucket predictors initially invalidated unchanged auxiliary receipts. The final contract separately checks selected cap meanings and preserves original unchanged auxiliary provenance.
These are native synthetic software defects, not attribution of all historical non-buys or proof of real financial opportunity loss.

implementation.valuation: Independent nullable market_cap_usd and fdv_usd, typed finite nonnegative USD scalars; zero is retained. Canonical key presence wins over raw aliases. FDV is never inferred from cap, and neither valuation is computed from circulating or raw total supply.
implementation.receipts: FDV participates in existing original HTTP-receipt freshness and field-specific merge. All valuation aliases are removed when freshness rejects the observation. Chosen zero/value/source/timestamp stay together; current cap meaning is explicit and old receipts are not upgraded by a later marker.
implementation.selection: Basic filters no longer substitute FDV for missing cap. Measured liquidity/volume zero is not rescued by raw aliases. Cap thresholds and unknown-cap policy are unchanged. Priority/dynamic cap buckets use an older buy value only if the canonical key is absent, not when it declares unknown/zero.
implementation.tail: Pure native projection/receipt/common-merge cases retain +500,+1000,+25000,+1000000 percentage-point momentum. This neither admits every such token nor proves profitable entry, exit or runner capture.
implementation.learning: New t0_valuation_proof is metadata outside the77 raw predictors. Native builder derives consistent cap buckets; Series, original frozen entries, Parquet, financial source and scalar/batch inference retain and recheck it. Strict identity/T0/value/exact-float32/receipt-age/meaning checks reject rehashed incompatible input.
implementation.training: Cap-using models require their own original current-generation population with at least30 rows and30 distinct tokens, and a matching numeric semantic schema. Each family target is checked separately. Without support, only incompatible cap/bucket predictors are excluded; unchanged historical numeric/auxiliary meanings and original financial targets remain usable. A later standalone marker cannot upgrade a legacy original entry.
implementation.automatic_generation: Runner advisory pipeline14 invalidates the obsolete input-generation fingerprint. No model is activated or operationally trained by this stage; isolated synthetic fits use temporary directories.
implementation.preservation: Protected operator .env, models, policies, data, archives, logs and .venv are not synchronized or rewritten. Cap is provider-reported, not independently verified circulating cap. Supply units and depth/route verification remain separate.
